en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing an arched city gate integrated into adjoining buildings on a cobbled street. Above the arch is a small balcony and a pavilion-like structure with shuttered windows. Two boys stand at the left side of the arch while a figure walks through the passageway. Printed German text appears beneath the image, and a red handwritten number is at the right edge.
